newsitem.title: USA: Masco acquires cabinet hardware maker.
newsitem.headline: Masco acquires cabinet hardware maker.

text.p: Masco Corp said Tuesday it acquired Liberty Hardware Manufacturing Corp, a producer of cabinet and builders' hardware and drawer slides, for an undisclosed amount of cash.
Based in Boca Raton, Fla., privately held Liberty Hardware has annual sales of about $30 million and serves residential and commercial markets, Masco said.
Liberty Hardware will operate as a wholly owned subsidiary of Masco, and Liberty's president, Lothar Mayer, and the rest of the company's top management team will remain in place.

Liberty produces, assembles and distributes a broad range of products from its 126,000-square-foot facility in Greensboro, N.C., and maintains distribution centers in other strategic U.S. locations, Masco said.

Liberty's products are designed with components from manufacturers in Europe, China, Taiwan and other countries around the world and are sold at retail and to original equipment manufacturers of kitchen cabinets and bath vanities, furniture and other products for the home.
"Liberty provides a strategic addition to Masco's core businesses and is a good fit in our overall strategy for growth," Masco Chairman Richard Manoogian said in a statement.
